name: Porteñolandia
detailed_description:
Porteñolandia (also known as Portenolandia) is an open-world sandbox action game that lets you explore the wildest limits of your imagination.
We’re on the island of Porteñolandia, a parody of the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires, Argentina, where you can dive into a wide variety of chaotic and hilarious activities.

Drive iconic old-school cars at full speed while fleeing the police, visit shops and stores that look oddly familiar (you can buy stuff... or rob them), interact with bizarre street characters, run into spicy protests, and much more.

About its development:
Porteñolandia is the passion project of Agustin Julian and Federico M. Kelly, who, at just 20 years old, dared to create their own open-world sandbox inspired by Buenos Aires and Argentine culture — all from their laptops at home.
Despite not having massive investors or large teams behind them, nothing stops them from building the dream that every Argentine gamer has had at least once in their life.

short_description: This is Porteñolandia, baby! Steal a "bondi", gamble playing "truco", race down the streets, collect vintage stickers, hide from the cops in a cyber café, and crash for the night inside a dumpster. All in a fictional Buenos Aires where chaos and smooth talk rule. You gonna miss it?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 / AMD Athlon 64 X2 6000+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600 GT / AMD Radeon HD 2600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with DirectX
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: The game runs on most PCs manufactured in the last 15 years.
